data.text:
BZ_N opcode broken in simulator: all three BZ variants (BZ, BZ_T, BZ_N) were decoded identically in cpu.cpp — all set bz_flag=true without distinguishing which variant. Branch resolution only checked `if (this->z_flag)`, meaning BZ_N (branch when Z=0) was treated the same as BZ_T (branch when Z=1). This caused SLT+BZ_N loop patterns to fail (loop runs only 1 iteration).

Fix: Added `bz_negate` field to d2e pipeline register. During decode, set `bz_negate = (i.ireg.opcode == ANEM_OPCODE_BZ_N)`. During branch resolution, use `bool take_branch = bz_negate ? !z_flag : z_flag`.

Files changed: cpu.h, cpu.cpp, snapshot.cpp

Status: FIXED in this session.
